name: Pactly
summary: An eight-page sales CRM with a deal board, a draggable week schedule and invoices you stamp paid
about: A sales CRM for a team that sells to customers and sends invoices, such as an agency or a service business. Deals move across a bold drag-and-drop board, meetings are dragged around a week calendar, and invoices are built line by line, then stamped PAID. Sample data is in US dollars.
how: Use the navy sidebar to move between the eight pages; collapse it to icons, or open it from the menu button on a phone.
On Deals, drag a block to the next stage; when it lands on Won you can raise the invoice in one click. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip.
On Schedule, drag a meeting to another day or time (it snaps to 30 minutes), or focus it and use the arrow keys. Undo is in the toast.
Create an invoice with line items, quantities and prices; the totals and tax update as you type.
Open an invoice to send it, print it, edit it or press Mark as paid to slam the PAID stamp on the paper.
Search, filter and sort contacts, products and invoices; Reports shows aging, collection rate and more.
Settings saves company details, tax, invoice prefix, payment terms, reminders, the theme and can reset the demo data.
